notes: A claim is early when its loss date is within N days of the contract effective date
Window shown as the headline early-claim KPI
An open claim reported MORE than this many days before the as-of date counts as aged 30+ (same rule as core dim_claim.aging_30_plus)
Components shown on the claims KPI page
Dealer scorecard: watch when the T12 loss ratio (incurred / earned claims reserve) is above this
Dealer scorecard: the loss-ratio watch needs at least this much T12 earned claims reserve
Dealer scorecard: watch when more than this share of T12 remittances were late
Dealer early-claim watch of record: contracts with a first claim (denied included) within this many days of effective; same window as the Actuarial page dealer list
Dealer early-claim watch: needs at least this many contracts effective for the whole window (actuarial early_claim_by_dealer min_exposed)
Dealer early-claim watch: actual-to-expected early-claim contracts at or above this (expected = portfolio rate of each contract's own product segment)
Dealer early-claim watch: Poisson z score (actual - expected) / sqrt(expected) at or above this
